name: Blatchford District Energy Sharing System
operator: Blatchford Renewable Energy Utility (City of Edmonton)
capacity_MW: Energy Centre One 1-3 (unverified split); expansion adds 13.1
planned: full build-out about 46,800 MWh/yr heat (34.5 MW peak), 43,700 MWh/yr cooling; boreholes 570 -> 2,100
sources_of_heat: geoexchange boreholes; sewer heat 'in design and construction'
outside_heat_terms: Bylaw C17943 has no rules or prices for outside heat; service can be cut for 'undue or abnormal fluctuations' s.41(g)(ii)
source_url: Blatchford District Energy Design Guide v8 (June 2025); Bylaw C17943; blatchfordutility.ca (library: blatchfordSHX2026, blatchfordRates2026, blatchford2023) ; City of Edmonton District Energy Strategy, Aug 2022, Table 1 p.8 and pp.9-10 (library: edmDEstrategy2022)
notes: only operating low-temperature network found in Edmonton; utility finances at risk (figures from news, unverified) | Strategy (2022) treats 'Blatchford / Royal Alex / Kingsway' as ONE opportunity area: 'ongoing system construction and operation'; Phase 1 'expand established DE node in Blatchford'; Phase 4 transmission piping from a 'city-scale low-carbon energy centre north of Downtown' to Blatchford, Exhibition Lands and Downtown. E06 sits inside this area.

name: DDEI Phases 1A-4 and full build-out

notes: a data centre downtown would compete with planned Gold Bar effluent heat; site maps currently count these phases as if built
